exploit_name: Uniswap oracle validatePrice can be griefed per block via sync()
description: The function returns false when blockTimestampLast == block.timestamp. A mempool attacker can front-run victim transactions by calling the permissionless sync() function on the Uniswap V2 pair.
attack_scenario: Attacker calls sync() before victim's tx in same block. blockTimestampLast equals current block timestamp. Victim's validation fails.
root_cause: The function returns false when blockTimestampLast == block.timestamp. A mempool attacker can front-run victim transactions by calling the permissionless sync() function on the Uniswap V2 pair.
fix_description: Remove the strict equality check. Allow validation to proceed when pair was updated in the same block.
notes: Per-block griefing of validation. Victims must use private mempools or accept repeated failures.
